This backup feature uses “All files access” for SmsForwarder.json in Download. This gives broad access to shared storage. Open Android settings, allow access for this app, then return.
This web client feature uses “All files access” to read a folder in Download. This gives broad access to shared storage. Open Android settings, allow access for this app, then return.
Sends this phone’s configuration to the server phone and replaces its configuration there.
Gets the configuration of the server phone and replaces the configuration of this phone.
Saves this phone’s configuration to a file.
Replaces this phone’s configuration with the one in the file.
The help above works offline. The button opens the project page on GitHub, which sees your IP address.
